_note: M7-P1. Everyone starts on Standard (kids see 'Steady'). After offerAfterLosses lost runs in a row on the same floor, Guided is kindly offered (at most once a day, never mentions losing, never switches by itself). homeLine shows once. Guided can also be picked any time in Settings. Wording: C9 (PR #115); the offer wording is from the Learning Designer review (PR #114). Only fight-button names (COUNTER, STRIKE, DASH) are in caps; menu buttons use normal case.
